name: KIM-1 Development (6502 dev environment for Mac)

mentions.name: KIM-1 Development (6502 dev environment for Mac)
mentions.description: A 6502 development environment for the Mac, assembled with help from Claude, for compiling and linking 6502 assembly for the PAL-2 (a modern KIM-1 re-creation). The GitHub repo includes everything needed plus setup instructions, and some programs from The First Book of KIM re-formatted into a modern style compatible with modern assemblers.
mentions.problem: The author wanted a way to compile and link the 6502 assembly programs from The First Book of KIM on a Mac.
mentions.source_excerpt: I wanted to be able to compile/link the assembly from the book so leaned on Claude to set up a 6502 dev environment for my Mac. I put everything needed (and instructions) on GitHub [3].
mentions.author: JKCalhoun
